verses.text: Yuj chi', hex xajanab'il wu'uj, haton juntzanh tik yalnakkan Dios t'ayonh. Yuj chi' ko wach' aktejekkan masanil juntzanh tz'ak'an juwokel ko niwanil yet' ko pensar t'a yichanh Dios. Kak'ek wal kip ko wach' ak'anoch ko pensar t'a Dios, yujto te ay yelk'och t'ayonh.
Hak'ek och he k'o'ol t'ayonh. Malaj junok hex b'aj ochnak ko mul. Malaj junok hex ko junakel he pensar. Malaj pax junok hex ko k'exanh ti'ejnak hex.

Manh yujok wak'anoch junok tas t'a heyib'anh swalanb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex. Yujto toxo ix wal t'ayex to te na'an hex ku'uj. Yuj chi', wach'chom pitzan honh, mato tzonh chami, palta junnhej kaj heyet'ok.
Tzex wak'och yipok hin k'o'ol, tzex walan wach'il. Wach'chom niwan yahelal tz'ak'ji'och t'a kib'anh, palta heyu'uj sniwanaj hin k'o'ol swab'i. Tzin tzalaj wal heyu'uj.
Yiktax ix honh jawi t'a Macedonia tik, maxtzak yal kik'an jab'ok kip, yujto ha juntzanh yahelal tik oyanoch t'a ko patik kichanh. Anhej owal tz'ak'ji'och t'a kib'anh. Xiwelalnhej kaji.
Palta ha Dios tz'ak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol jantak mach ayoch t'a skusk'olal. Ha ix ak'an sniwanil ko k'o'ol, yujto ix ja winhaj Tito t'a tik.

Manh yujoknhej to ix ja winhaj Tito chi' ix ak'ji sniwanil hin k'o'ol, palta tzonh tzalaj pax heyu'uj, yujto ix heyak' sniwanil sk'o'ol winh ayik ix ek' winh t'ayex. Ix yalan winh t'ayonh to he gana tzin he yila'. Ix yalanpax winh to tzex kus wal yuj jun ix uji t'a he kal chi'. Ix yalanpax winh to tzin he nakoti. Yuj chi' ix wach' ja hin tzalajk'olal heyu'uj.

Wach'chom te kusnak hex yuj jun carta hin tz'ib'ejnakb'at t'ayex, palta maxtzak hin kus yuj tikne'ik. Wach'chom t'a sb'ab'elal kusnak hin yuj jun carta chi', yujto wab'nak to kusnak hex jaye' k'uhal yuj.

Haxo tikne'ik, tzin tzalaji manh yujok to kusnak hex yuj, palta tzin tzalaj tikne'ik, yujto yuj jun he kusk'olal chi' ix he na he b'a. Ix hex kus icha wal t'a snib'ej Dios, yuj chi' manh jab'ok ix juwi'el he pensar wu'uj.

Tato tzonh kus icha wal snib'ej Dios, yuj jun ko kusk'olal chi' sko na ko b'a yik tzonh kolchaji. Tato icha chi', max honh te kuslaj yuj. Palta ay junxo makan kusk'olal. Ha jun chi', yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik yaji. Ha heb' skus icha chi', tonhej sb'atkan heb' t'a chamel t'a jun'elnhej yuj.

Palta ha hexxo tik, ochnak he kusk'olal icha snib'ej Dios. Yuj chi' na'ekkoti tas ajnak hex yuj. Ochnak hex wal t'a ilk'olal sik'lab'il. He sayannak modo tas tz'aj he kolan he b'a. Kotnak heyowal yuj jun chukal ujinak t'a he kal chi', xiwnak hex pax yuj. He nib'ejnak wal hin he k'umej. He nanak heyak'b'at t'a yib'anh jun winh ochnak smul chi'. Icha chi' heyutejnak he ch'oxani to manhxo hex lokanok t'a jun chukal chi'.

Ha jun hin carta chi', manh yujok jun winh ochnak smul chi' hin tz'ib'ejnakb'ati. Manh yujok pax jun mach yab'nak sya'il yuj jun chukal chi'. Palta hin tz'ib'ejnakb'at t'ayex yik snachajel heyu'uj to ha t'a yichanh Dios, te xajan honh heyu'uj.

Yuj chi' ix ak'ji sniwanil ko k'o'ol. Manhoknhej ix ak'ji sniwanil ko k'o'ol. Ix wach' ja pax ko tzalajk'olal ayik ix yalan winhaj Tito to ix te tzalaj winh heyet'ok, yujto ix wach' ja sniwanil sk'o'ol winh heyu'uj he masanil.

Ha t'a yalanh, ix walel he wach'il t'a winhaj Tito tik. Haxo tikne'ik, max hin k'ixwi, yujto walnak jun chi'. Masanil tas kalnak t'ayex, te yel. Hanhejtona', ayik skalan he wach'il t'a winhaj Tito tik, te yel juntzanh skal chi'.

Ha winh tik, te xajan hexxo pax yuj winh tikne'ik, yujto snakot winh tas heyutejnak he k'anab'ajan tas yalnak winh t'ayex. Sna'anpaxkot winh to emnakil heyutejnak he b'a he cha'an winh, xiwk'olal heyutejnak he b'a t'a winh.
Tzin tzalaj tikne'ik, yujto syal hex wak'anoch yipok hin k'o'ol.
